dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_drunkard.men: Ask him to open the wall
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_drunkard.tow: Hic... friend, I'm parched. Something sweet. A honey bottle. Then I'll tell you my best story.
Ahh, sweet. ...Here's my best one. Under the sky there's another sky. Down at the bottom of the earth. Where the four heartbeats go home, someday.
My old man used to say the sky down there looks up at this one from below. ...Hic. Just a drunk's babble. Forget it.
Hey, d'you hear it? ...No? Go put your ear to the far wall down here.
You heard it. That's wind. Wind being sucked down, from above to below, into the deep.
There's a passage behind it. Whoever built the tavern bricked it up. ...I've got the key. But it's too early. Not till you've given back more heartbeats.
...You came. You smell of ash. You've given back three. It's time for the key.
You saw the door. ...Beyond it is the road to the sky below. Give back the fourth, and the key will point down. Come see me then.
Me? I'm not going. I knew one who went and came back. ...He'd forgotten his own name.
(The drunkard slides an old key into a seam in the wall, and two stones fall away inward.) ...Go on. There's a door at the end. Don't try to open it. Just look.
Will you hear a request? Every morning someone leaves a flower on the nameless grave. I've never once seen who.
Pick me a flower. I'd like to lay it beside mine. Whoever they are, it's lonely to mourn alone.
...Thank you. This morning's flower was this very colour. Same field, same flower.
Did you come by early this morning? ...I see. You didn't.
I found letters on the nameless grave's stone, under the moss. My eyes can't make them out. Would you fetch a bucket of water? We'll wash it.
Let's see... there. Not a name. Just one line.
"Write it down before you forget." ...Who was it meant for, I wonder. The one under the stone, or the one standing before it?
Last night someone started digging up the nameless grave. The earth is fresh. The footprints lead into the capital, toward the house of mourning on the south road.
The prints were about... the size of your boots. Would you go and look? I'd rather not go near that house.
Earth on the empty chair. A line traced in the ash on the table... "Back again."
...That grave was there before I became keeper. No one knows who dug it. I have a feeling the rest will come clear further on.
This may be my last request. I'd like to light a candle before the nameless grave. Would you bring me one?
It's lit. ...The truth is, yesterday I looked beneath the grave. The coffin was empty. It's been empty all along.
This grave was dug by someone who meant to lie in it "one day". With no name carved. For someone whose name isn't settled yet.
When you've gone further and come back, we'll talk again. Perhaps by then the letters will be readable.
You're with the apprentice? The test has two parts: drive off four night beasts, and bring back three bones. That's all a back demands.
The old pages of the roll? ...Yes, there's one line without a name. The ink is dry, but there are no letters.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_innkeeper.to: Oh, this child! Her family's been searching all night. ...Come here, there's warm milk. You'll sleep in one of our beds tonight.
She was in the house of mourning? ...That family's girl vanished on a thunder night three years ago. About this one's age.
The rest? My grandmother used to sing it. "Each time it rings, one does not return." ...Not a song for bedtime.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_mapmaker.men: Have it drawn on my map (5 bell coins)
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_mapmaker.tow: Let's see, I'll draw it in. For the titans' grounds, I have the bearings in my head.
Rumours, I've plenty. Let me trace the places that aren't on your map yet.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_perch_keeper: The sea song? I heard it on the beach as a child. "At the road's end, a shell rings." That's all I remember.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.town_f: The boy built a forge? ...Hmph. Not bad. He laid the magma well. Who taught him that, I wonder.
They say a blade forged in that ash keeps a red line even when it cools. ...Don't tell the boy. It'll go to his head.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_storage_keep: Folk from the shore leave many parcels here they never collect. ...I know the song. "Those who do not return count in the tide's deep."
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_tool_merchan: Lay out the fisher's catch? On tide market days I'll lend him half my shopfront. ...With all the tide shell talk, fish will sell dear.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_apprentice.hand_: How did it go? Have you got three bones?
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_apprentice.idle: I can tie these knots with my eyes shut now.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_apprentice.meet: Oh... are you a whale chaser too? I'm only an apprentice. I'm scared to sit the guild's test alone.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_apprentice.meet2: Will you sit it with me? Ask the clerk at the desk what the test is. Everyone who rides a titan's back passed it, they say. The traveller who came before, too, I bet.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_apprentice.passe: We did it...! We'll both be on the roll now. The clerk said there's a line on an old page with no name written in it.
Maybe someone left before they could write it. ...Here, my father's iron. Still too heavy for me. You use it.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_apprentice.wait_: The clerk's at the guild hall on the east avenue. I'll practise my knots here.
Four night beasts. Three bones. ...It'd help if you went first. I'll stay behind and keep count.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_ash_apprentice.b: I lit the forge. The ash melted. ...And in the fire I saw a thread of light. Running down and down. Below the forge floor, further down.
The master says to forget I saw it. But I'm telling you. I think it's a road home, to somewhere.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_ash_apprentice.h: Got the blast furnace and the magma?
Hand over the blast furnace and magma
Now I can build it! I'll go show the master... no, you tell him. If I say it, he'll yell that I'm not ready.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_ash_apprentice.i: The ash is warm. In my hand it almost seems to pulse, slowly.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_ash_apprentice.m: You're headed for the ember mountain, right? I'm apprenticed at the smithy. I bagged ash from the mountain and hauled it here. This ash never cools.
The master's forge won't melt it. I need a new one. One blast furnace, and four magma blocks from the Nether to line the floor. ...Can you help?
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_ash_apprentice.w: Magma blocks lie around low in the Nether. Watch your feet. A blast furnace takes a furnace, iron, and smooth stone.
The master's behind the smithy counter.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bard.back: Let me hear them. ..."At the road's end, a shell rings." "Each time it rings, one does not return." "Those who do not return count in the tide's deep."
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bard.back2: Ah, it continues. It continued. ...So this was a song of the sea counting people. Take this as thanks. An old disc of mine, with a song from somewhere far away.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bard.idle: ♪ When the tide draws back, a road appears...
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bard.meet: Well met, traveller. I gather songs as I walk. I have a sea song, but it breaks off. "When the tide draws back, a road appears"... and nothing after.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bard.meet2: Someone in the capital may remember the rest. The perch keeper, the innkeeper, the storage keeper. Would you ask the three of them for me?
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bard.wait_listen: Bring me their words just as they say them. A song only grows in other people's mouths.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bellkeeper.back: I heard it. ...You rang it only once?
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bellkeeper.back2: There was a second toll. Late, and from the same height. Too clear for an echo.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bellkeeper.back3: No, just an old man's ears. Thank you. From today the town can count its days again.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bellkeeper.idle: May the bell ring at the same pitch today, too.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bellkeeper.meet: Ah, young one. I'm the bell keeper. ...Was, I should say. My knees won't allow the tower stairs any more.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bellkeeper.meet2: The top bell hasn't rung since the night the shadow passed. A bell counts the days. A town that stops counting forgets which day it is.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bellkeeper.wait_: The tower stands on the north terrace. Ring it once, then come straight down.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_bellkeeper.why: The one below calls people. The one on top speaks to the sky. ...Once is enough. Ring it once, then come straight down.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_child.at_inn: It's warm here. ...I should have brought her too.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_child.find2: Nobody uses this bed. I thought the thunder wouldn't find me here.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_child.find3: ...But at night there's someone else in this room. A kid my size. She never talks.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_child.find3.go: Let's go to the inn. There are lights there
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.back: The merchant gave us a spot! ...The night before I ran, something like a pearl caught in my net. When I looked in, it seemed to look back. I threw it into the sea.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.back2: You're the one heading out to sea, I reckon. Take a rod instead of a net. When I can go back to the shore, let's meet again.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.hand_ask: Got the string and the cod?
Hand over the string and cod
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.handed: Bless you. Now I can cast again. I'd like to borrow the tool merchant's shopfront for the market, but I'm no talker. Would you ask for me?
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.idle: The smell of the tide is still on my fingers.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.meet: You from the capital? I fished the east shore. ...Used to. The night the tide shell came, the sea pulled back all at once. I dropped my net and ran.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.meet2: When the tide returns, there's a market. The tide market. Put fish on a stall there and I could eat again. But look at this net. Eight strings and three cod. Can you manage?
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.wait_gath: String from spiders, cod from river or sea. ...If the sea scares you, the river's fine.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_fisher.wait_mark: The tool shop's on the east corner of the square.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_herbalist.hand_a: Show the brewing stand and the wart
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_herbalist.handed: Good. Boil the wart in water first: that's your base. What you add next decides what it becomes. ...There, the stand is yours. Take it with you.
One thing. Never put the ember mountain's ash into a potion. You fall, down and down, in your dreams. No one has come back yet.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_herbalist.idle: Herbs remember the weather they were picked in.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_herbalist.meet: My, you smell of ash, child. Wouldn't you like to brew the medicines the apothecary doesn't sell?
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_herbalist.meet2: Build yourself a brewing stand. And bring three Nether wart. Without it, every potion is just water.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_herbalist.wait: The wart grows in soul sand beside the fortress stairs. A brewing stand takes a blaze rod and cobblestone.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_weaver.hand_ask: Have you got the copper and the rod?
Hand over the copper and the rod
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_weaver.handed: That'll do. ...Cloth woven on thunder nights sometimes grows a pattern by itself. A wing. A bird I've never seen, and yet it feels familiar.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_weaver.handed2: Take this spyglass as thanks. My father used it on the peaks. From somewhere high, you can see the sky's shadow clearly.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_weaver.idle: A broken thread can be tied. A melted needle is gone for good.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_weaver.meet: Look at this needle. Lightning came in through the window and melted only the loom's iron needle. Not a scorch on the cloth.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_weaver.meet2: My mother said the wind folk let lightning pass through copper. Six copper ingots, and a lightning rod for the roof. Then I can weave again.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_weaver.wait: Copper shows as green streaks, not deep in the hills. A lightning rod is three ingots stacked upright.
item.skyabyss.town.child_drawing.lore: A great wing in the sky. Beneath it, two children holding hands. One face is scribbled out.
lore.skyabyss.town.bell_echo.body:
I rang the bell atop the great tower, once.

The bell keeper says he heard a second toll. Late, and from the same height.

There was no one on the tower but me.
lore.skyabyss.town.bell_echo.title: The Echo of the Top Bell
lore.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.body:
The drunkard's tale, in the tavern cellar.

Beneath the sky there is another sky, at the bottom of the earth. The place where the four heartbeats go home, someday.

The sky below looks up at the sky above.
lore.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.title: The Sky Below
lore.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.body:
I put my ear to the far wall of the tavern cellar.

I heard wind. Wind drawn from above to below, down into the deep.

There is a passage behind the wall. The drunkard has the key.
lore.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.title: The Bricked-Up Wall
lore.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.body:
Deep in the tavern cellar, at the end of the passage behind the bricked-up wall, there is a sealed door.

Nothing is written on it. Only, at the height of the handle, the greasy mark of a hand.

The same size as mine.
lore.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.title: The Sealed Door
lore.skyabyss.town.grave_1.body:
I laid a flower on the nameless grave outside the west gate.

The gravekeeper said the flower left there each morning is the same colour as the one I picked. Same field, same flower.

I did not go to the graveyard this morning.
lore.skyabyss.town.grave_1.title: Flowers on the Nameless Grave
lore.skyabyss.town.grave_2.body:
When we washed the moss from the nameless grave, a single line appeared.

"Write it down before you forget."

The same hand as the first line in the camp notebook.
lore.skyabyss.town.grave_2.title: One Line Under the Moss
lore.skyabyss.town.grave_3.body:
The footprints from the nameless grave ended at the house of mourning on the south road.

A table set with one plate too many. Graveyard earth on the seat of the empty chair. One line traced in the ash on the table.

"Back again."

The finger that traced it was as wide as mine.
lore.skyabyss.town.grave_3.title: The Table in the House of Mourning
lore.skyabyss.town.grave_4.body:
I lit a candle before the nameless grave.

The gravekeeper said the coffin has always been empty. That it was dug by someone who meant to lie in it "one day".

The place for a name is still blank.
lore.skyabyss.town.grave_4.title: The Empty Coffin
lore.skyabyss.town.well_song.body:
Beneath the old well, at the end of a narrow way. On the wall, the same carvings as in the hall of songs.

The carving stops partway, as if the hand meant to finish it stopped there.

Held to my ear, the shard from the chest hummed the same song, far away.
lore.skyabyss.town.well_song.title: The Song at the Bottom of the Well
message.skyabyss.town.mapmaker.cost: Drawing it in costs %s bell coins.
message.skyabyss.town.mapmaker.drawn: "%s" has been drawn on your map (M).
message.skyabyss.town.mapmaker.none: Mapmaker: Nothing left to add to your map, I'm afraid.
message.skyabyss.town.mapmaker.nothing_t: There is no ground left to draw in.
message.skyabyss.town.mapmaker.rumor: Mapmaker: "%1$s" lies %2$s of the capital, about %3$s blocks.
message.skyabyss.town.rumor.well: One of the grates on the old well to the southwest comes loose, they say. The children swear there's something down there.
message.skyabyss.town.well.found: In the chest at the bottom of the old well: bell coins, and a shard that hums faintly.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.done: Beneath the sky there is another sky. So the drunkard said.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.hand.hand: Give the honey bottle to the drunkard
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.hand.journa: You have the honey. Give it to the drunkard.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.honey.journ: The drunkard in the cellar of the Deep Cup tavern wants something sweet. One honey bottle.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.rumor: The drunk in the tavern cellar says he'll tell his best story for something sweet.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.summary: Bring the drunkard something sweet, and hear his best story.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_1.title: Another Sky
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.back.journa: Behind the wall, wind was being drawn downward. Tell the drunkard.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.done: There's a passage behind the wall. Too early for the key.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.listen.jour: The drunkard says to put your ear against the far wall of the cellar.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.listen.list: Put your ear to the far cellar wall
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.rumor: The drunkard's been going on about the cellar's far wall making noises.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.summary: Put your ear to the far wall of the tavern cellar.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_2.title: Wind Behind the Wall
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.back.journa: You saw the sealed door. Tell the drunkard.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.done: Beyond the sealed door, they say, is the road to the sky below.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.open.journa: Three heartbeats returned. The drunkard says he'll open the far wall of the cellar.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.open.open: Have the drunkard open the wall
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.rumor: The drunkard said, dead sober, that it's time to hand over the key.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.summary: Open the cellar's far wall with the drunkard's key, and see the door at the end of the passage.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.title: The Old Key
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.walk.journa: The wall is open. Go see the door at the end of the passage. Don't try to open it.
quest.skyabyss.town.cellar_3.walk.walk: Walk to the end of the passage
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_apprentice.clerk: Ask about the test at the guild desk
The apprentice is afraid to sit the test alone. First, ask the guild desk what the test involves.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_apprentice.done: The apprentice's name is carved into the guild roll. The line beside it is still blank.
Give the bones to the apprentice
That's everything. Go back to the apprentice and hand over the bones.
Two tasks: drive off four night beasts, and bring back three bones. That's all you need on a titan's back, they say.
A rumour from the innkeeper: an apprentice due to sit the guild's registration test lodges at the old soldier's house on the south road.
Meet the apprentice chaser (old soldier's house, south road)
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_apprentice.rumor: An apprentice is lodging at the old soldier's house on the south road, about to sit the guild's test. Says it's lonely going alone. Go say hello.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_apprentice.summa: Sit the guild's registration test together with an apprentice whale chaser.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_apprentice.title: The Apprentice Chaser
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.back.journa: It rang. Go down and tell the bell keeper.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.done: The town counts its days again. The bell keeper never spoke of the second toll again.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.meet.journa: A rumour from the innkeeper: the bell keeper wants someone to ring the top bell. He's at the scribe's house west of the square.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.meet.meet: Meet the bell keeper (scribe's house, west of the square)
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.ring.journa: His knees can't take the tower stairs. The top bell hasn't rung since the night the shadow passed. Climb the tower and ring it once.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.ring.ring: Ring the bell atop the great tower
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.rumor: The old bell keeper of the great tower is looking for young legs to ring the top bell. He rooms at the scribe's house west of the square.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.summary: Ring the bell atop the great tower for the old bell keeper.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch1_bell.title: The Bell Keeper's Request
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.back.back: Bring the verses to the bard
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.back.journa: Three verses gathered. Take them to the bard.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.done: The song goes on now: a song of the sea counting people.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.listen.inn: Ask the innkeeper about the sea song
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.listen.jour: The bard's song stops at "When the tide draws back, a road appears." The perch keeper, the innkeeper and the storage keeper may know more.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.listen.perc: Ask the perch keeper about the sea song
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.listen.stas: Ask the storage keeper about the sea song
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.meet.journa: A rumour from the innkeeper: a bard is renting a house on the south avenue.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.meet.meet: Meet the bard (lodgings on the south avenue)
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.rumor: A bard has taken a house on the south avenue. He's hunting for the rest of a sea song, and wants to hear from the townsfolk.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.summary: Gather the lost verses of a sea song from the people of the capital.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_bard.title: The Wandering Bard
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.back.journal: The spot is secured. Tell the fisher.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.done: For the first time in a long while, fish lie on the tide market's stalls.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.gather.journ: He dropped his net and ran the night the tide shell came ashore. He needs eight strings to mend it and three cod for the market.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.gather.strin: Gather string to mend the net
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.hand.hand: Give the string and cod to the fisher
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.hand.journal: That's everything. Take it to the fisher.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.market.journ: The net is mended. The quickest way to a stall is to borrow the tool merchant's shopfront. The fisher isn't one for talking.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.market.marke: Ask the tool merchant for a market spot
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.meet.journal: A rumour from the innkeeper: a fisher who fled the shore is staying at the fisher's house on the east avenue.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.meet.meet: Meet the fisher (fisher's house, east avenue)
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.rumor: A fisher who abandoned the shore because of the tide shell has moved into a house on the east avenue. Wants to sell at the tide market, but his net is torn.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.summary: Mend the net of a fisher who fled the tide shell, so he can sell at the tide market.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch2_net.title: The Fisher's Net
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.done: The child fell asleep in a bed at the inn. She left a drawing behind.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.escort.i: Walk the child to the Bell Inn
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.escort.j: She was curled up on a bed no one uses. The inn has lights. Take her hand and walk her to the Bell Inn on the west avenue.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.find.fin: Find the child (house of mourning, south road)
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.find.jou: The youngest of the big family hid on a thunder night and hasn't come home. She was seen heading toward the house of mourning on the south road.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.inn.ask: Leave the child with the innkeeper
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.inn.jour: You've reached the inn. Ask the innkeeper to look after her.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.rumor: The youngest of the big family hides whenever thunder rolls. She did it last night and still hasn't turned up. ...Someone saw her heading toward the house of mourning on the south road.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.summary: Find the child who hid on a thunder night and never came home, and bring her to the inn.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_thunder.title: Thunder Night
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.done: The loom runs again. On thunder nights, they say, a wing pattern weaves itself in.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.gather.jo: The wind folk let lightning pass through copper, they say. Six copper ingots, and one lightning rod for the roof.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.hand.hand: Give the copper and lightning rod to the weaver
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.hand.jour: That's everything. Take it to the weaver.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.meet.jour: A rumour from the innkeeper: lightning melted a loom needle at the weaver's house on the west avenue.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.meet.meet: Meet the weaver (weaver's house, west avenue)
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.rumor: Lightning melted the needle in the weaver's loom, west avenue. She insists copper will let the lightning pass.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.summary: Bring copper and a lightning rod to replace the loom needle melted by lightning.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch3_weaver.title: The Weaver's Needle
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.back.journal: The smith approved. Let the apprentice know.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.done: A new forge burns in the smithy. Some say a thread of light runs down through its fire.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.gather.journ: The master's forge can't melt ember ash. One blast furnace, and four magma blocks from the Nether to line its floor.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.gather.magma: Gather magma blocks from the Nether
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.hand.hand: Give the blast furnace and magma to the apprentice
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.hand.journal: That's everything. Take it to the apprentice.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.meet.journal: A rumour from the innkeeper: the smith's apprentice wants a new forge for the ember mountain's ash. He's at the apprentices' lodging on the south road.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.meet.meet: Meet the smith's apprentice (apprentices' lodging, south road)
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.rumor: The smith's apprentice hauled ash back from the southern mountain. He's fired up about building a new forge.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.smith.journa: The forge is built. The apprentice is afraid to tell his master. Tell the smith yourself.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.smith.smith: Tell the smith about the new forge
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.summary: Help the smith's apprentice build a new forge that can melt the ash of the ember mountain.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_ash.title: The Ash Apprentice
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.done: You learned how to brew. Only the ash, she said, must never go in.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.gather.jou: Build a brewing stand yourself and bring three Nether wart. Both come from near the Nether fortresses.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.hand.hand: Show the brewing stand and wart to the herbalist
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.hand.journ: That's everything. Show it to the herbalist.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.meet.journ: A rumour from the innkeeper: the old herbalist wants to teach brewing. She lives in the herb house on the south road.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.meet.meet: Meet the old herbalist (herb house, south road)
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.rumor: The old herbalist wants to teach someone the brewing stand. But you have to bring her Nether wart first.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.summary: Show the old herbalist a brewing stand and Nether wart, and learn to brew.
quest.skyabyss.town.ch4_herbs.title: The Herbalist's Pot
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_1.done: The flowers were from the same field, the same colour.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_1.flower.journ: The nameless grave outside the west gate. Someone leaves a flower there every morning. Pick a flower and bring it to the gravekeeper.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_1.lay.journal: You have a flower. Give it to the gravekeeper and lay it together.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_1.lay.lay: Give the flower to the gravekeeper
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_1.rumor: The gravekeeper wants help with the nameless grave. His hut is outside the west gate.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_1.summary: Someone leaves flowers on the nameless grave every morning. Lay one with the gravekeeper.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_1.title: The Nameless Grave
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_2.done: The words were not a name.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_2.rumor: The gravekeeper found letters on the nameless grave's stone. He needs water, apparently.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_2.summary: Wash the moss from the nameless grave's stone and read what lies beneath.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_2.title: Letters Under the Moss
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_2.wash.journal: You have the water. Bring it to the gravekeeper.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_2.wash.wash: Give the water to the gravekeeper
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_2.water.journa: There are letters under the moss on the nameless grave. Fill a bucket with water and bring it to the gravekeeper.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_3.back.journal: Earth on the empty chair in the house of mourning. One line traced in the ash on the table. Tell the gravekeeper.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_3.done: The footprints ended at the house of mourning.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_3.rumor: The gravekeeper is troubled again. Someone tried to dig up the nameless grave in the night.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_3.summary: Follow the footprints of whoever tried to dig up the nameless grave.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_3.title: Turned Earth
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_3.visit.journa: Someone tried to dig up the nameless grave in the night. The footprints lead into the capital, toward the house of mourning on the south road.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_3.visit.visit: Follow the footprints (house of mourning, south road)
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_4.candle.journ: Bring the gravekeeper a candle to light before the nameless grave.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_4.done: The grave was dug for someone who would "one day" lie in it. The rest lies further on.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_4.light.journa: You have a candle. Give it to the gravekeeper.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_4.light.light: Give the candle to the gravekeeper
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_4.rumor: The gravekeeper wants to light a candle at the nameless grave.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_4.summary: Light a single candle before the nameless grave.
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_4.title: A Candle
quest.skyabyss.town.grave_tbc: The gravekeeper's tale continues in chapter six.
